findings.explanation: Ownership of the intellectual property in your deliverables is shared immediately upon development without being conditioned on full payment, meaning the client acquires rights before you are paid.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of all Intellectual Property Rights resulting from any development made by the Contractor shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has made full payment for the applicable deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I would like to suggest a small adjustment to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms share ownership of the intellectual property immediately upon development without being conditioned on full payment. I propose that we modify this so that ownership of all Intellectual Property Rights resulting from any development made by the Contractor shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has made full payment for the applicable deliverables. Thank you for your time and understanding.
